scope: Supply, install and remove a free-standing hoarding around three sides of the kiosk in the outdoor rooftop car park

extra_lines.desc: Wind loading for external install: 10 extra uprights (34 in total) and 8 counterweights per upright

price_notes: This hoarding is outdoors, so it is strengthened against wind with 40% more uprights and 8 counterweights per upright. Wind-rated hoardings are priced on application (POA) under the rate card.
terms_notes: This is an external hoarding. Prices exclude a certified wind-rated design unless stated.
